subject: Compliance MAP: clarifying data-retention window & DPA timeline for Silverline
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Asha Desai <asha.desai@silverlinebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed MAP & security checkpoints for Silverline pilot

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP_Silverline_v1.xlsx) that maps the security/compliance milestones we discussed to deliverables and owners. High-level asks from your side to help us move forward:

- Confirm preferred data-retention window for pilot logs/backups (30 / 90 / 365 days).
- Confirm whether you require an on-prem export option for audit logs.
- Share the completed SIG/CAIQ worksheet you have so we can mark items Redwood needs to address.

Planned MAP milestones (proposal):
1) SIG/CAIQ intake and evidence items — target two weeks
2) SOC 2 snapshot review (Redwood SOC2 summary attached) — target three weeks
3) DPA review & signature (use our template or yours) — target 4–6 weeks depending on procurement
4) Final acceptance checklist and pilot sign-off — target week 6

If you want to shorten the SOC 2 evidence review we can provide a narrower set of artifacts and a short walkthrough with our security team.

I've attached our MAP and a SOC 2 snapshot for your team to review. Let us know availability next week for a short evidence walkthrough (30 minutes).

Thanks —

Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Silverline_v1.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2_Snapshot_2027.pdf

From: Asha Desai <asha.desai@silverlinebank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Jenkins <paul.jenkins@silverlinebank.com>
Date: 2027-07-09T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & security checkpoints for Silverline pilot

Hi Grace —

Appreciate the MAP. I've attached our completed SIG/CAIQ (Silverline_SIG_CAICQ.xlsx) with a few clarifying notes in column G — most items are "in scope" but procurement will want to walk the DPA redlines. A couple of quick answers up front:

- Retention: our default for external SaaS pilots is 90 days for logs and 365 days for customer data unless otherwise negotiated. Can you confirm Redwood's default retention for pilot artifacts and whether we can set a shorter window for initial evaluation?
- On-prem export: not required for the pilot, but we will need a documented log export procedure for audit purposes.
- SOC 2: procurement will want a PDF of the latest SOC 2 summary and the auditor contact info (we have a short checklist we run through).

Paul (procurement) is looped in to coordinate the DPA cadence. Can you send your DPA template and an expected timeline for legal review?

Thanks —

—Asha Desai
Lead Information Security Analyst
Silverline Bank
asha.desai@silverlinebank.com | +1 (212) 555-0789

Attachments: Silverline_SIG_CAICQ.xlsx

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Asha Desai <asha.desai@silverlinebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Paul Jenkins <paul.jenkins@silverlinebank.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & security checkpoints for Silverline pilot

On Thu, Jul 9, 2027 at 11:04 AM Asha Desai <asha.desai@silverlinebank.com> wrote:
> Thanks Grace — attached our SIG/CAIQ and notes.

Thanks for the sheet, Asha — that helps a lot. I've updated the MAP to reflect the items you flagged in column G and added owners and required evidence types. Key clarifications and proposals below:

- Retention windows
  - Proposal A (default): Logs retained 90 days, customer data 365 days.
  - Proposal B (pilot-short): Logs retained 30 days for the pilot only, customer data 365 days.
  - We can implement Proposal B for a 30-day trial if Silverline confirms in writing; it requires a short config change and a retention addendum to the DPA.

- SOC 2 evidence
  - Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Snapshot_2027.pdf (summary of controls + auditor contact). For the intake review we can provide:
    - SOC 2 summary + scope page (attached)
    - Mapping of controls to SIG/CAIQ questions (we will deliver within 5 business days after you confirm which SIG sections you prioritize)

- DPA timeline
  - If Silverline uses Redwood's DPA template (attached), legal review is typically 14–21 business days for standard redlines.
  - If Silverline proposes material changes, add 2–4 weeks depending on procurement/legal capacity.

- Suggested MAP schedule (adjustable):
  - Week 0 (today): SIG intake and MAP alignment
  - Week 1–2: Provide SOC 2 artifacts + control mapping; Silverline to review
  - Week 2–4: DPA negotiation (target sign by end of week 4 if using Redwood template)
  - Week 5–6: Pilot deployment and acceptance

Next actions for us:
- Grace/Redwood: deliver control mapping to SIG within 5 business days once you mark priority items in the spreadsheet.
- Silverline: confirm whether you prefer Proposal A or Proposal B for logs retention, and which SIG sections to prioritize.

Sending our DPA template now.

Best,

Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Template_v2.docx, Redwood_SOC2_Snapshot_2027.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Desai <asha.desai@silverlinebank.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Jenkins <paul.jenkins@silverlinebank.com>
Date: 2027-07-16T15:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & security checkpoints for Silverline pilot

Hi Asha / team —

Following up with a couple of operational notes from the GTM side to help unblock acceptance testing quickly:

- Canary deployment: we can provision a restricted pilot environment limited to Silverline's test dataset and a reduced retention window (30 days) to accelerate the SIG/SOC review. This is often enough for InfoSec to validate controls before full production.
- Evidence package delivery: we can do a 30-minute walkthrough with your InfoSec team next Tuesday (7/20) where we present the SOC 2 snapshot and the ctrl->SIG mapping. Please confirm who will attend.
- DPA: using Redwood's template will usually keep the legal review in the 14–21 business day range. If you need an internal PO or contract routing steps, let us know so we can coordinate procurement paperwork.

HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/SLB-2027-07 (I've added the MAP there; deal id SLB-2027-07).

If we can get confirmation on a 30-day log retention for the pilot by 7/19 we can run the canary environment and have the walkthrough next week.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: Asha Desai <asha.desai@silverlinebank.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Jenkins <paul.jenkins@silverlinebank.com>
Date: 2027-07-21T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & security checkpoints for Silverline pilot

Hi Grace / Marissa —

Thanks for the clarifications and the walkthrough offer. Quick decisions from our side: 

- Retention: procurement prefers default behavior but InfoSec will accept a 30-day logs retention for the pilot if it's formalized in the DPA addendum. For now, we confirm Proposal B (30-day logs during pilot) conditioned on a retention addendum.
- SOC 2 walkthrough: Asha, myself, and Paul (procurement) will attend the 7/20 session — please include auditor contact info in the deck.
- DPA timeline: Paul — procurement needs ~45 calendar days for review and PO routing on our side. Can Redwood accommodate that lead time while we do the SOC review in parallel?

Paul Jenkins <paul.jenkins@silverlinebank.com> here — confirmed. 45 days is realistic for legal + procurement redlines and internal approvals. We appreciate Redwood sharing the template up front; we'll flag any major redlines early.

Next actions:
- Redwood: include the retention addendum language in the DPA and share final DPA by 7/23 so procurement can start the clock.
- Silverline: we'll prioritize SIG sections A–D for control mapping and provide feedback after your walkthrough.

Looking forward to the walkthrough.

—Asha

Attachments: none
